                                                 )
                                             )
                                             .setGranularity(granularity)
                                             .build();
      final CacheStrategy<ResultRow, Object, GroupByQuery> strategy =
          new GroupByQueryQueryToolChest(null).getCacheStrategy(query);
      final ResultRow result = query.getResultRowHasTimestamp()
                               ? ResultRow.of(timestamp, "#en.wikipedia", null, 10516, 21032, 31548)
                               : ResultRow.of("#en.wikipedia", null, 10516, 21032, 31548);

      final Object preparedValue = strategy.prepareForCache(true).apply(result);
      Assert.assertEquals(
          Arrays.asList(timestamp, "#en.wikipedia", null, 10516, 21032, 31548),
          preparedValue
      );

      final Object fromCacheValue = objectMapper.readValue(
          objectMapper.writeValueAsBytes(preparedValue),
          strategy.getCacheObjectClazz()
      );

      Assert.assertEquals(result, strategy.pullFromCache(true).apply(fromCacheValue));
    }
  }

'''
